articleTitle: Calculated Elastic Constants of CdS and CdTe Thin Films with Cubic and Hexagonal Crystal Structure for Stress Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Young's modulus (E) and Poisson's ratio (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$v$</tex>) are critical for the theoretical calculation and experimental determination of residual stresses that occur during the growth of semiconductor thin films. This paper introduces generalized expressions for E, v and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$E/(1-v)$</tex>) for hexagonal and cubic structures common to cadmium sulphide and cadmium telluride semiconductors. These elastic constants are found to be invariant within the c-plane. Numerical values for these constants have been computed and tabulated for CdS and CdTe.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Accuracy of Machine Learning Methods in Prediction of Students Success
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: One of the main factors affecting the future opportunities and career development of students is the results of the educational process. A high level of success in education makes it possible to obtain qualified specialists in the future and ensure economic growth. Prediction of success is an urgent task, because a quick response to possible problems allows to increase the student's chances of successfully passing the session, as well as to identify deficiencies that can be corrected. In the work, a study of the accuracy of predicting the success of students based on data on their attendance and grades was conducted. The following machine learning algorithms were studied: Logistic Regression, Support Vector Method, Random Forest. The parameters characterizing the accuracy of the classification are determined, namely: sensitivity, specificity and balanced accuracy. Based on the obtained results, receiver operating characteristic graphs were constructed to assess the ability of the classifier to correctly recognize positive classes and reject negative classes when the threshold value changes. In order to perform forecasting, data on user ratings and attendance for the first and second semesters of the 2021–2022 academic year were exported from the Moodle electronic learning management system database. The total number of student grade and attendance records exported to files was 1,308,262. The creation of predictive models was performed in the PyCharm development environment in Python using the Scikit-learn library. After performing the calculations, it is determined that the random forest method performs the best prediction of success based on the available input data and has a higher accuracy. The obtained accuracy value of 80% and AUC of 73% indicates the quality of the classification model and good discriminating power of the model. The graph of the receiver operating characteristic for the random forest method shows that it has a clearly defined area under the curve that is more curved up and to the left, which confirms the effectiveness of the model. The obtained results can be used as a basis for further research.

articleTitle: Influence of surface effect on linear vibrations of multi-walled nanoshell
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: from the variational approach to describe shell-like vibrations of nanotube. The nonlocal elasticity, Sanders-Koiter shell theory and surface effect are implemented in the nanotube mathematical model. The Galerkin method in the form of weight residual technique is used to transform the PDEs into the system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) with respect to the generalized coordinates. The parameters of linear vibrations are analyzed from the eigenvalue problem. The influence of surface effect and nonlocal elasticity on the nanotube eigenfrequencyies is studied by using the obtained model. The surface effect affects significantly on the shell-like nanotube eigenfrequencies. These eigenfrequencies are increased, when the surface effect is considered. If nonlocal elasticity is considered, the eigenfrequencies of nanotube are decreased in comparison of nanostructure eigenfrequencies without accounte of nonlocal elasticity.

articleTitle: Development and Experimental Study of a Plasma Flow Generator for Dermatological Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of the work was to propose a device that produces low-temperature plasma, which, having the same healing effect, but produces a smaller burn in the area of action. Consequently, recovery is faster and there is less discomfort during the procedure. The results showed that the proposed circuit is capable of stably generating pulses required for dermatological procedures.

articleTitle: Technological Control of the Petroleum Pretreatment Unit Based on the Indicator of Its Relative Dielectric Permittivity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The possibility of using the relative dielectric permittivity indicator for monitoring and controlling the operation of the primary oil pretreatment unit was presented. It was defined that relative dielectric permittivity significantly depends on both the hydrocarbon composition of oil and the presence of impurities such as water, sulfur, and chloride salts. It is proposed to use an algorithm based on measuring the relative dielectric permittivity to determine the level and quality of oil pretreatment.

articleTitle: Open-Pit Railway Transport Traction Complex Power Consumption Mode Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper is a study of the power consumption modes of an open pit rail transport traction complex. To study the power consumption modes of the rail transport complex, a model of a traction transformer substation that supplies part of the traction network was developed in a visual programming environment, and the operation of a traction network consisting of four locomotives with different control angles of the rectifier of each locomotive was Simulation. Using the IEEE 1459–2010 standard, the order of distribution of power components for a three-phase circuit is calculated. The obtained results indicate a clear asymmetry of voltage and current caused by the peculiarities of the AC contact network. The current distortion power, under all modes, on the primary and secondary windings has a slight difference, and the voltage distortion power on the side of the contact network significantly exceeds this indicator on the source side.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methods of Building and Researching of Fuzzy Cognitive Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The report presents the results of a comparative analysis of methods for parameterization of cognitive models based on the use of fuzzy set theory and antonym logic. Reasoned expediency of using methods of the logic of antonyms in the construction and research of cognitive models of weakly structured situations. An approach to calculating the magnitudes of the indirect and total influence of factors on each other in certain types of cognitive models built based on the logic of antonyms is proposed.

articleTitle: Explore the Feasibility of Moving an Implant Along an Arc Trajectory for Half a Circle in a Magnetic Stereotaxic System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this paper, a method for improving the accuracy of a magnetic stereotaxic system is described and the feasibility of the method is established by computer simulation experiments using simulation software. Five large permanent magnets were used to form an external magnetic field so as to non-contact control the movement of an implant along an arc trajectory for half a circle inside a container, and the changes in the magnetic field around the small permanent magnets during the movement were recorded.

articleTitle: Management of Power Grid Modes in Conditions of High Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This work is the result of research on the problem of controlling the modes of electric power networks. The work focuses on methods and technical means of correcting the parameters of the modes of electric networks in conditions of their heterogeneity. The idea of the work is to use volt-added transformers to equalize the potentials of long networks powered by several sources by switching windings that excite different phases of the network. The paper reflects the design of such transformers and the results of their computational and experimental study, including in operating networks.

articleTitle: Specific Electrical Resistance of Coke as a Characteristic of its Consumer Properties
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: As a result of the study of coke obtained from the production charge of one of the leading coke chemical enterprises of Ukraine, it was established that the level of final coking temperatures, which ensures the formation of the required consumer properties of blast furnace coke, should not be lower than 1000 °C. The temperature level for obtaining ferroalloy coke of proper quality is lower - 900–960 °C.

articleTitle: Laser Processing Parameters Optimization of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Structural Plastics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Composites based on continuous carbon fiber and polymer resins (CFRP) offer higher weight strength than many structural metals, enabling significant weight reductions in various industries. A key challenge in fabricating complex CFRP structures is the trimming of blanks, which often leads to delamination and defects when using traditional methods like milling or waterjet cutting. While laser cutting mitigates some damage, differences in absorption and thermal conductivity between carbon fiber and epoxy resin result in uneven heating and defect accumulation. This study aims to identify the most effective operational modes of shortpulse femtosecond lasers to optimize processing speed and surface quality in CFRP trimming. A series of experiments determined the most efficient laser ablation parameters for CFRP, defined as the ratio of ablated material volume to applied energy. Results showed that increasing the pitch value (distance between parallel laser scanning tracks) improves ablation efficiency but reduces uniformity and predictability. Optimal efficiency is achieved with pitch values of 0.7-1 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> at 2.5-3 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{J}$</tex> energy, and 0.1 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.4 \mu ~\mathrm{m}$</tex> at 3.5- <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4 \mu ~\mathrm{J}$</tex> energy. Higher energy values decrease efficiency. Larger pitch values result in increased processing roughness and depth, with significant variations observed at higher energies. SEM analysis indicated uniform surfaces post-ablation, with reduced epoxy resin and exposed carbon fibers. EDS analysis revealed a slight increase in carbon content and a decrease in oxygen, indicating selective epoxy resin ablation. These findings suggest that ablation efficiency and surface quality depend nonlinearly on pitch width and pulse energy, offering a narrow window for optimal CFRP laser processing. These results can enhance CFRP cutting, texturing, and drilling, potentially improved by adjusting laser wavelength or adding special additives to the polymer matrix.

articleTitle: Zinc Oxide Based Particles with Hierarchical Structure for Surface Wetting Modification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The wettability of surfaces with water is crucial for a variety of technical and natural processes, including self-cleaning surfaces, improving the corrosion resistance of materials, ensuring reliable adhesive contact and efficient condensation of water vapor to collect atmospheric water. Research in this area involves the development of new materials and technologies that allow us to control the wetting properties of surfaces, ensuring their optimal functionality in various applications. This study focuses on the possibility of using micro- and nanotextured particles to modify the wetting properties of functional coatings. Superhydrophobic surfaces, characterised by exceptional water repellency, serve as a model system, demonstrating that both the intrinsic hydrophobicity of the surface and the development of the texture are crucial. The synthesis of hierarchically structured particles, in particular ZnO from SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> seed crystals, followed by their combination with polymeric binders to create surfaces with increased roughness is discussed in this paper. The high particle content (90–95 wt%) in binder-deficient systems contributes to superhydrophobicity, which is confirmed by the water contact angle of 153° for ZnO with TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> seed crystals. This approach not only simplifies the dispersion of particles in the polymer matrix but also offers a practical way to scale up the production of superhydrophobic surfaces.

articleTitle: Control of Voltage-Source Series-Resonant Inverters With Extended Topology Using Pulse-Density and Pulse-Frequency Modulations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents a control strategy for series resonant voltage-source inverters with extended topology using both pulse-density modulation (PDM) and pulse-frequency modulation (PFM). PDM regulates the output current for pulse density values from 0.5 to 1, while PFM applies for values below 0.5. The features of this strategy are: 1) when the half-bridge part of the extended inverter is utilized under PDM, the injection interval duration is a multiple of the half-cycle of the inverter output period, enabling the solution of the voltage imbalance problem; 2) using PFM completely avoids amplitude fluctuations in the output current, thereby inherently eliminating the voltage imbalance problem. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Distribution Network with the D-STATCOM and Photovoltaic Power Stations Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article presents a model of a distribution electrical network, which includes photovoltaic power stations 1 MW and D-STATCOM. By the Simulink MATLAB, the mode of operation of the photovoltaic power stations with a change in the sun irradiance is simulated. At the same time, there are sudden changes in the network voltage and unacceptable voltage deviations. The simulation showed that the installation of D-STATCOM in the 35 kV network allows to reduce voltage fluctuations and ensure standardized power quality indicators.

articleTitle: Regulating the Properties of Dielectric Materials in the MgO – Al2O3 – TiO2 System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Products made from granular masses of periclase can be used for lining high-temperature furnaces and apparatus operating at temperatures up to 2273 K in air or even in alkali metal vapors. Periclase has also found its use as an electrical insulating material. To expand the range of resistance of periclase products, the TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> additive began to be used. The presence of this oxide lowers the firing temperature and increases the heat resistance of products. The next innovative solution was the decision to use alumina-magnesia spinel MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> as an additive, which is positive for heat resistance, mechanical strength and does not actually reduce electrical resistance. This work establishes the mechanism of solid-phase exchange reactions that determine the subsolidus structure of the MgO – Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> – TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> system. In the region of the elementary triangle Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> – MgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> – MgO, only compounds with a cubic crystal lattice are present, which gives them isotropy and, along with the difference in thermal coefficients of linear expansion, allows us to expect the production of materials with high heat resistance, resistance to corrosion and high electrical resistivity. This is also confirmed by the high temperatures of eutectics in this region. Thus, theoretical studies of the subsolidus structure of the MgO – Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> – TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> system made it possible to predict the compositions of dielectric materials in the concentration range quandilite – periclase – spinel. The main physical and mechanical properties of materials whose compositions belong to this concentration range were experimentally studied.

articleTitle: Modeling of Soft Switching Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The report describes the operating principle of the power part of a DC-DC converter (DCC) with phase control and auxiliary circuits. The features of controlling the power transistors of the inverter are described. A virtual model of the DCC in the MATLAB/Simulink environment is presented. The simulation results are presented (steady state, external characteristics and other dependencies), as well as the results of comparing the measured characteristics with the theoretical ones.

articleTitle: Using NaïVe Bayes Classifier to Indentify Falsified Text Information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The present study investigates the problem of spreading fake text news within the framework of AI-driven generative technologies. This research builds upon prior works into methodologies for categorizing such data within contexts marked by societal instability. The naïve Bayes classifier was adopted as the primary method, leveraging a feature set derived from an analysis of deceptive news attributes. To evaluate model performance in terms of both speed and accuracy, a method employing linear additive convolution with weighted coefficients was employed. A hybrid neural network, developed in preceding research, served as a benchmark for comparison. The findings indicate that the proposed probabilistic approach exhibits superior effectiveness. Nonetheless, given the specific nature of this comparison, these outcomes lay groundwork for further exploration into the applicability of the chosen model family.

articleTitle: A Method for Deterministic Signal Detection on the Background of Noise Based on the Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technologies that meet the modern requirements of Industry 4.0 are being used in various branches of human life. The use of these technologies becomes possible due to the development of the computational systems capacity and the increase in the quantity of different sensors for collecting data and information. To solve radio engineering problems, the classical tools of probability theory and mathematical statistics is usually used. This also applies to the tasks of detecting useful signals on the background of interferences and noises. The purpose of this paper is to experimentally study a method for detecting deterministic signals in the case of noise presence using a neural network. In general, the proposed method has high accuracy results at a signal-to-noise ratio of at least -20dB. With a further decrease in the signal-to-noise ratio, this method is characterized by an increased probability of a second-order error.

articleTitle: 2D MoS2 Layer as Element of Terahertz Range Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: To enhance device and circuit functions many new reconfigurable technologies of run-time control ware explored. Owing to their atomic-thin thickness and high sensitivity to external electrical fields two-dimensional (2D) materials can provide a suitable platform for those technology. The ability to use 2D semiconductors for reconfiguration of antenna parameters in terahertz region is considered. A patch antenna composed square metallic element, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MoS}_{2}$</tex> layer, and a metal ground plane feeding by microstrip transmission line is studied in frequency range of 300 - 500 GHz. GaN is used as a dielectric substrate forming hybrid 2D/3D heterojunction with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MoS}_{2}$</tex>. Optical pump as a factor impacting to conductive, and impedance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MoS}_{2}$</tex> layer is considered. Model parameters and material properties for antenna application were discussed. Antenna characteristics, depending on <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MoS}_{2}$</tex> layer properties have been determined by ANSYS HFSS software.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Silicon p-i-n Photodiode with Increased Collection Coefficient of Minority Charge Carriers and Responsivity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The effect of crystal thickness on the photovoltaic parameters of silicon photodiodes, in particular, the collection coefficient of minority charge carriers and responsivity, was investigated. Taking into account that the investigated photoiodides had a significant area, a decrease in the crystal thickness provoked a decrease in their mechanical strength. It is proposed to increase the mechanical strength of crystals by thinning only the projections of the sensing elements on the reverse side. It is shown that reducing the thickness of the photodiode crystal from 500 µm to 300 µm allows obtaining samples with a 25% higher sensitivity at a reverse voltage of 2 V due to an increase in the intensity of radiation absorbed in the space charge region and a crystal thickness equal to the diffusion length of minority charge carriers after reflection from the gold layer. It was also found that the proposed photodiodes had a lower dark current and a slightly higher capacitance than the serial ones. When measuring the spectral characteristics of the sensitivity, it is seen that the proposed photodiode has a higher sensitivity in the entire wavelength range in which it is sensitive

articleTitle: Electromechanical Systems Continuous Diagnostics Through Parametric Identification and Products Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Formalized universal approaches, which can be suitable for industrial products digitalization implementations providing the real time continuous technical diagnostics of electromechanical systems are developed. These approaches are based on the parametric identification of electromechanical systems by means the least square method with digitalization of real time measurements data. Increasing of the diagnostics accuracy with decreasing of the time discretization step of measured data digitalization shown through computer simulations proves correctness of the developed generalized approaches and it gives the ways of the further researches.

articleTitle: How the Parameters of Pulse Electrolysis Determine the Structure of Chromium Oxide Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The present work was devoted to a study of the influence of pulse electrolysis parameters on the structure of chromium oxide composites. The morphology and elemental composition of the composites formed on stainless steel AISI 304 were investigated using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX). The electrochemical properties and defects of the composites were studied by impedance spectroscopy. It has been established that varying the duration of pulses and pauses during electrolysis significantly affects the crystal size, the presence of cracks, and the uniformity of element distribution on the surface of the composites. Specifically, it was found that composites formed with pulse and pause durations of 1 second and 0.25 seconds, respectively, exhibit a crystalline structure with average crystal sizes of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$104 \pm 11 ~\text{nm}$</tex> and are free of surface cracks. Increasing the pause duration to 0.5 seconds leads to the formation of cracks on the composite surface with sizes of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$220 \pm 10 ~\text{nm}$</tex> and an increase in crystal size to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$149 \pm 11 ~\text{nm}$</tex>. Composites with pulse and pause durations of 0.5 seconds display a globular structure and an island-like formation mechanism, with a network of cracks <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$800 \pm 50 ~\text{nm}$</tex> wide on the surface. The study also revealed that changes in current density amplitude during electrolysis do not affect the crystalline structure of composites formed with a pulse duration of 1 second and a pause of 0.25 seconds. However, decreasing the current density to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$30 ~\mathrm{A} / \mathbf{d m}^{2}$</tex> results in composites with wide and deep cracks. Conversely, composites formed at a current density of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$90 ~\mathrm{A} / \text{dm}^{2}$</tex> are free of cracks, while those formed at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$130 ~\mathrm{A} / \text{dm}^{2}$</tex> exhibit a crack network on the surface. These findings indicate that the structural and electrochemical properties of chromium oxide composites can be precisely controlled by adjusting the parameters of pulse electrolysis.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling and Optimization of Solar Cells Based on the WSe2/MoS2 p-n Heterojunctions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Solar cells (SCs) based on two-dimensional (2D) materials are of constant interest among engineers and scientists for applications in the field of renewable solar energy. The main advantages are their high efficiency of solar energy conversion, long-term stability, and low cost of production. However, to achieve maximum performance, it is necessary to investigate and optimize these elements. In this work, an analysis of the performance characteristics of solar cells based on the WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> absorbing layer and the MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> transport layer was carried out, and the optimal conditions for obtaining a solar energy conversion efficiency of 24.26% were determined. Light is absorbed by the WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer, forming electron-hole pairs (excitons). Due to the difference in energy levels at the heterojunction interface, excitons are separated into free electrons and holes. Electrons move into the MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer, and holes remain in the absorber layer, providing charge separation and reducing recombination. Free electrons and holes are transported to the corresponding electrodes, generating an electric current. As a result of the research, a series of computer simulations of the operating characteristics of photovoltaic solar energy converters was performed, skills were acquired in working with transport models, and conclusions were drawn regarding the specifics of their application.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Electromagnetic Transients of a Frequency-Controlled Propeller's Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: To solve the practical problem of reducing energy costs in the transport industry, it is important to increase the energy efficiency of the fleet of diesel units, for which modern designs of power plants and energy sources for them are being researched and created, in particular, the installation of electrical elements of power plants based on modern conversion technology, and the development of modern motion control algorithms. In the context of solving this problem, the article shows the process of improving the method of dynamic inductances, which is supplemented in terms of taking into account the electrical and magnetic asymmetry of the circuits of the induction motor and extended to a new class of systems - ship propulsion electromechanical AC systems, which allows to increase the accuracy of the result of taking into account the saturation processes and reduce the level of consumption of diesel generator power plants of vehicles due to asymmetric electromagnetic processes in the windings of the traction motor. The presented transient characteristics show the stability of the developed power plant control system when the active resistance and inductance of the stator circuit change. The peculiarity of the developed power plant control system is its structure, all the coefficients of which depend only on the parameters of the real power plant, which simplifies the adjustment in real conditions and does not require additional modelling, forecasting or separate reference data, but only requires measuring the static parameters of the power plant.

articleTitle: Influence of Swarm Connectivity on l-Best PSO Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Particles' connections fullness in a swarm and its influence on l-best PSOs' are the issues of the study. The difference between g-best and l-best is given. A general algorithm RSTC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">J/K</inf>-PSO with variable level of particles' connectivity is described. Based on the bunch of benchmarks the study of l-best PSOs' performance is carried out. The influence of local paricles' neighborhood and their arrangement are studied. Some practical recommendations are given to find the reasonable level of particles' connectivity.

articleTitle: Effect of Transition to Impurity Continuum on Thermoelectric Properties of the Semiconductor $\left(\text{Bi}_{1-\mathrm{x}} \text{Sb}_{\mathrm{x}}\right)_{2} \text{Se}_{3}$ Solid Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The dependences of thermoelectric parameters (the Seebeck coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex>, electrical conductivity <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma$</tex>, thermoelectric power factor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex>) and microhardness <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex> on the composition of polycrystalline semiconducting (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\left.\text{Bi}_{1-\mathrm{x}} \mathbf{S b}_{\mathbf{x}}\right)_{2} \text{Se}_{3}$</tex> solid solutions (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x=0-0.2$</tex>) were obtained at room temperature. It was shown that all measured parameters vary nonmonotonically, exhibiting two extrema in the range of composition <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x=0-0.04$</tex>. At <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$x>0.04$</tex>, the dependences become monotonic: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex> increase, while <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P$</tex> decrease. We explain the observed behavior of thermoelectric characteristics and microhardness by the existence of a transition of percolation type to impurity continuum and subsequent selforganization processes taking place in a solid solution with the possible formation of complexes and infinite cluster passing through them.

Author Keywords: $\left(B i_{1-x} S b_{x}\right)_{2} S e_{3}$ solid solutions

articleTitle: Modelling of a Technical Diagnostic System for a Generator Based on an Internal Combustion Engine(ICE)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach to diagnose autonomous power-generating equipment derived from an ICE by means of computer modeling of the performance of the technical diagnosis system. The essence of the proposed method is the possible mathematical determination of diagnostic parameters of the system, which allows analytically determining the degree of wear of the cylinder-piston group. Determining the currents of the electric starter allows One to establish the functional parameter - the real degree of compression. Determining the compression ratio allows One to set the energy indicators of the generator. The use of this method made it possible to establish the dependence of specific energy indicators on the technical condition of the generating plant. As a result of the conducted research, a multi-level hierarchical multi-component model of the system of technical diagnostics of the generator based on the ICE was created, which allows to predict the diagnostic parameters of the research object and select the necessary diagnostic tools. The calculated data obtained from the developed mathematical model of an electric generator with a single-cylinder engine with spark ignition based on real parameters shows the high adequacy of the proposed mathematical model.

articleTitle: A Zero-Watermarking Algorithm for Use in RGB and Monochrome Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article proposes a method of zero-watermarking for colored RGB bitmap images. This algorithm can be used to protect property rights to multimedia resources in which it is impossible to use ordinary watermarks due to the impossibility of changing the image (such as medical data where high accuracy is required and the appearance of artifacts is unacceptable) or due to the presence of a higher distortion of the container. This algorithm is based on DWT, SVD and operations in the field by modulo 256. The software implementation of the algorithm was developed (using the Accord and Math.NET libraries to implement DWT, SVD). The software implementation of the algorithm was tested. This algorithm has advantages in the form of normalization of the average error, but it needs further research to improve its performance.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Graphene Monolayer on Metal Substrate: Resonance Regimes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The interaction of electromagnetic field with a graphene layer with rough interface grown on a metal substrate is studied. Particular attention is devoted to the role of rough (periodic) boundary in shaping the scattered field. The correlation between changes in the scattered field and variations in graphene's chemical potential, excitation parameters, and thickness of graphene layer is revealed and analyzed. Methods to control this scattered field response electromagnetically are proposed. The findings have applications in graphene metamaterials and devices, monitoring setups for electron beam parameters, and quality control in the manufacture of gratings and coatings.

articleTitle: Cloak Control of Thermal and Electric Fields in Anisotropic Semiconductor Concentrically Inhomogeneous Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The principle for designing a two-dimensional concentric semiconductor two-layer structure bifunctionally invisibility in terms of its thermal and electrical properties is proposed in this study. The structure consists of an inner circular isotropic region, a background isotropic one, and two anisotropic concentric circular layers in between. The principle is based on the appropriate effective medium approach created by using the Wiedemann-Franz law and Schulgasser's formula. The proposed principle shows off a perfect cloaking performance for electrical and thermal properties of the structure. The effective response of the structure in the form of electric and thermal fields are calculated analytically using the obtained effective medium approach. To validate the principle and analyze the evolution of the above response of the considered structure, numerical simulations were carried out using COMSOL software.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Ensemble Classifier in Medical Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the current scientific and technical problem of constructing a diagnostic decision support system in medicine based on a heterogeneous ensemble classifier model that implements two approaches to formulating a diagnostic conclusion: a probabilistic one based on the analysis of the training sample, and expert information on the structure of symptom complexes. The choice of prototype matching method as a probabilistic component is justified. Formalization of expert information on the structure of symptom complexes was carried out by representing symptom complexes of diseases with numerical intervals of linguistic variables. Options for taking into account expert assessments about the structure of symptom complexes in an ensemble classifier are considered. Test verification of the developed classifier was done on real medical data and confirmed the effectiveness of its work.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Model of the Ship System «Voltage Source Inverter with Pulse Width Modulation - Asynchronous Motor»
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A substitution scheme and a refined methodology for determining the parameters of the high-frequency ship system «Voltage Source Inverter with Pulse Width Modulation - Asynchronous Motor» scheme have been proposed. This can be used for studying the operation of the ship's electrical power system and assessing the levels of electromagnetic interference in the system. The proposed scheme can be used for modeling and predicting high-frequency, common-mode, and differential electromagnetic interference. A comparison was conducted between the proposed scheme and well-known substitution schemes. An analysis of the results of computer simulations in comparison with experimental studies was carried out. During the analysis, both internal and parasitic parameters of the system were taken into account.

Author Keywords: Voltage Source Inverter with Pulse Width Modulation

articleTitle: Uncertainty of Patch Matching for Isotropic and Anisotropic Textures of Multimodal Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Image registration aims at aligning two or more images in a common coordinate system. A common approach is to find a geometric transformation that explains the parameters of putative correspondences between images. Each correspondence measures the spatial translation between local patches of the registered images. The uncertainty of this translation is important for registration task allowing to weight each correspondence with respect to others. Measuring uncertainty is challenging especially for multimodal registration case and for anisotropic textures. In this paper, we develop further a learning-based patch matching approach that predicts the covariation matrix of the translation error for each correspondence. We identify the bias related to the orientation of anisotropic textures and propose additional data augmentation and a modified loss function to eliminate it. Using multimodal remote sensing images, we confirm that the proposed approach predicts the covariation matrix of translation errors for both isotropic and anisotropic textures with different orientations.

articleTitle: Distribution of the Seebeck Coefficient in Bi2Te3 Obtained by Direct Melting Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The distribution of the Seebeck coefficient over the surface of a Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ingot obtained by direct alloying of bismuth (Bi) and tellurium (Te) in a stoichiometric ratio was investigated. The specimen obtained in this process is characterized by a non-uniform distribution of p- and n-type regions, possibly due to the uneven temperature distribution during crystallization. The obtained map of the Seebeck coefficient distribution provides information to suggest the direction of the crystallization front. This observation could be crucial for a deeper understanding of the processes occurring during the formation of the Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ingot and its structure. Further research in this direction may help optimize the process of obtaining the material with desired thermoelectric properties.

articleTitle: Stripping Voltammetry of Zn-Ni-Cu Alloy Nanoscale Films
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The voltammograms of ZnNiCu alloy films dissolution are presented in comparison with the voltammograms of CuNi, CuZn, ZnNi binary alloys dissolution. The films were obtained in a potentiostatic mode in ammonia-glycinate electrolytes and were anodically dissolved in alkaline ammonia-glycinate and sodium sulfate solutions. It was revealed that the ternary alloy film is multiphase and includes the α and ε-phases of the CuZn alloy, the γ- and β-phases of the ZnNi alloy, as well as the phase of pure Cu.

articleTitle: Resource-Saving Cryptography for Microcontrollers in Biomedical Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: With the advancement of medical technologies, there is an increasing need for the integration of modern biomedical devices that provide not only diagnosis and treatment but also continuous health monitoring of patients. One of the key requirements for such devices is ensuring the security and confidentiality of the processed data. This is especially relevant for implanted medical devices, which often operate autonomously and have limited computational resources. Microcontrollers used in medical implants typically have low performance and limited power consumption. Therefore, traditional cryptographic methods, which require significant computational resources, are not efficient for such devices. This necessitates the development and implementation of lightweight cryptographic algorithms capable of providing an adequate level of security without overburdening the microcontrollers. The article discusses contemporary approaches to lightweight cryptography, focusing on its use in medical microcontrollers. It analyzes existing methods, their advantages and disadvantages, as well as prospects for the development and implementation of new solutions in this field. Particular attention is given to issues of energy conservation and optimization of computational processes, which are critically important for ensuring the prolonged operation of implanted medical devices.

articleTitle: Strategies for Filtering Unwanted Comments in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In today's digital age, social media platforms have become an indispensable part of everyday life, revolutionizing communication and information exchange. However, with the freedom of expression afforded by these platforms comes the challenge of managing unwanted messages, ranging from intrusive advertisements to spam and propaganda. This issue has gained increasing relevance as undesirable comments can significantly distort public opinion and contribute to the spread of misinformation. To combat this problem, a comprehensive algorithm for filtering unwanted messages in social media comments has been developed. Grounded in text analysis, this algorithm employs three popular methods: convolutional neural networks, support vector machines, and k-nearest neighbors. Notably, the algorithm automatically determines whether a message is unwanted, based on the collective output of these methods. Before final decisionmaking, comment text undergoes preprocessing using efficient text processing algorithms to reduce noise and enhance analysis quality. Text preprocessing may involve steps such as stop-word removal, lemmatization, and vectorization. The resulting text is then inputted into each algorithm, which examines it for characteristics of unwanted messages. The strength of this comprehensive approach lies in its consideration of diverse text characteristics, improving the accuracy of unwanted message detection. To validate the algorithm's effectiveness, tests were conducted in the Telegram messenger, demonstrating successful filtration of unwanted messages and contributing to enhanced communication quality and prevention of undesirable information dissemination across social media platforms. Overall, the development and deployment of comprehensive algorithm for filtering unwanted messages play a crucial role in combating propaganda and misinformation, fostering a safer and more informed online environment.

articleTitle: Optimization in Speed of a Positional Electric Drive Using Refined Jerk Prediction Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Under conditions of limited intermediate coordinates of the electric drive, the problem of parametric optimization of relay systems is extremely simply solved by the N-i switching method. In combination with the technique of refined jerk prediction, previously substantiated for second-order systems, this method ensures that the transient characteristics of a positional electric drive are as close as possible to optimal performance. The use of relay-modal controllers, synthesized by distributing roots based on the parameters of optimal controllers, makes it possible to prevent overshoot and guarantee the extremely aperiodic nature of the transient process. The combined use of the three above-mentioned methodological techniques ensures the synthesis of a position control system with a simple structure and close to optimal performance.

articleTitle: Determination of the Distribution of Iron Oxide Nanoparticles Deposited on Textile Fibres with Limited Optical Observation Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The possibility of registering the nanoscale size of iron oxides embedded in textile fibers by optical microscopy has been proved. The distribution ofparticles onflax, cotton, wool and polyester fibers has been studied. The possibility of extrapolating the data to the nanoscale was revealed. A function that determines the distribution of particle sizes is proposed. The main constants characterizing the retention of nanoconstituents by fibers were determined. It is proved that the largest percentage of nanosizes is retained in flax fibers, and the smallest percentage in polyester fibers. The obtained results make it possible to predict the content of nanoconstituents from a mixture of divalent and trivalent iron oxides, which is the basis for the creation of magnetic smart materials

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Optimal Chemical Composition of Polymer Epoxy Composites for Electromagnetic Radiation Absorbing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of the research is modeling of optimal composition of polymer epoxy composites for electromagnetic radiation absorbing with increased set of strength properties. The tasks of the research are to identify the optimal chemical composition of polymer epoxy composites for electromagnetic radiation absorbing and to build models for forecasting their characteristics. The object of the research is modified epoxy resin, barium titanate and humic substances, the subject of research - computer modeling processes of optimal chemical composition of polymer epoxy composites for electromagnetic radiation absorbing. The research method is computer simulation in MathCad Prime 6.0. Models for forecasting the performance properties of polymer epoxy composites for electromagnetic radiation absorbing were built, which can be adapted to any content of barium titanate and humic substances. It was established that the best is polymer epoxy composites for electromagnetic radiation absorbing with 0.5 % mas. of humic substances and 10 % mas. barium titanate. For this composition the impact strength is 35 MPa and breaking stress during bending is 54 MPa.

articleTitle: Wide Band Gap Nanostructured Marshite and Digenite Films Deposited by Automatic SILAR Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this work, an automatic successive ionic layer adsorption and the reaction (SILAR) method was developed and approved to produce nanostructured films of two stable wide band gap semiconductors from the cuprous sulfide and cuprous iodide families. Studies of morphology, chemical composition and optical properties have shown that the semiconductor films obtained here on glass substrates are marshite and digenite. The approach presented here is highly manageable because it is fully automated. Additional advantages of the automatic SILAR method are scalability, low cost and availability, since a conventional 3D printer was used to create the process setup, and all operations for deposition of semiconductor layers were pre-programmed and carried out at atmospheric pressure and room temperature. It has been shown that the automatic SILAR method allows one to change the type of semiconductor simply by changing one aqueous solution used during deposition, so it is promising to create various semiconductor heterostructures for future micro- and nanoelectronics.

articleTitle: Using Electrospark Erosion Method to Obtain Metal Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The peculiarity of electrospark dispersion of conductive materials in a liquid is the direct obtaining of an ultrafine state of a substance, the dimensions of which are in the nanoscale range. The implementation of the electrospark dispersion method is carried out at a technological installation, which includes: a discharge pulse generator, a discharge parameter control unit, a discharge chamber, and measuring devices. Discharge pulse generators with capacitive energy storage have shown their high efficiency in spark erosion systems to produce powders with particle sizes from 10 nm to 100 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu m$</tex>.

articleTitle: Possibilities of Modern Stereoendoscopy in Rhinology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The main problem addressed in the article is limited visualization and insufficient accuracy when using traditional endoscopic methods in rhinology, which can lead to incomplete diagnosis and an increased risk of complications. Stereoendoscopy is characterized by the use of a two-camera system, which allows for a three-dimensional image of the surgical field. The results are explained by the use of stereoscopic technology, which improves spatial perception and visualization quality, allowing the surgeon to better navigate the complex anatomy of the nasal cavity and paranasal sinuses.

articleTitle: Drone Image Reconstruction Using Autoencoder Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to the process of investigation and development of the approach to the reconstruction of images taken from unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) for further work with them. Proposal of the approach is based on using neural networks with an auto encoder architecture, which allows us to reconstruct images with high accuracy. Experiments have shown that the mapped architecture demonstrates a high level of accuracy and brightness of the updated image. The results of the work can be used for developing processing systems for drones or other applications.

articleTitle: Features of Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation in 5-Phases Cascaded High Voltage Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to analyze the capabilities of space-vector pulse-width modulation when controlling a 5-phase high-voltage cascade frequency converter in normal mode and several types of emergency situations. Taking into account the large number of controlled power transistors, an asynchronous modulation method is proposed, based on calculating the amplitude values of individual phases at each time based on the duty cycle of space vectors, which allows the control system to use independent switching in each phase. In emergency modes, when individual H-bridges are damaged, it is proposed to use the balanced space vectors method, which ensures the symmetry of the electromagnetic field in the event of a short circuit of both individual cascades and one or two phases of the inverter. Methodology. We use a mathematical and geometric interpretation of variable amplitude space vectors when projecting voltages onto a symmetrical 5-phase load. Results. Analysis of the 1st harmonic of phase voltages showed that the use of the space vector modulation method in the normal operating mode of a 5-phase converter makes it possible to increase the utilization factor of DC voltage sources by 23.1% (instead of 15.6% for a 3-phase converter). If individual H-bridges fail and the voltages in the load phases are balanced, the utilization factor may decrease, but in any case it will remain greater than 1. In this case, the higher harmonics, despite significant distortions in the shape of the phase voltages, are mutually compensated in the electromagnetic field of the load, as evidenced by absence of pulsations and shocks on the graphs of transient processes of the electromagnetic torque of the engine. Balancing of the electromagnetic field in the load is maintained even if one or two phases of the inverter are short-circuited. This significantly increases the survivability of the electric drive, which is especially important in critical mechanisms and technological processes, where converters are used. The article presents calculation formulas, phase voltage graphs and simulation results for a 5-phase permanent magnet motor, explaining the principles of operation in normal and emergency situations, which can be used in the design of the converter control system.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Climatic Factors on the Properties of Plant-Polymer Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the study of the impact of climatic factors on the properties of plant-polymer composites. It has been shown that the developed plant-polymer composites, created based on secondary polyolefins and agricultural waste in the form of buckwheat and oat husks, do not fall short of their industrial counterparts, wood-polymer composites, in terms of resistance to the specified factors, according to the test results. It has also been noted that, considering the service life of industrial wood-polymer composite counterparts, it can be asserted that the service life of the developed plant-polymer composites based on secondary high-density polyethylene and plant-based waste is at least 20 years, and for based on secondary polypropylene and plant-based waste at least 25 years.

articleTitle: Transformative Neural Networks for Technical Text Generation: Context Length Dependence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article proposes a transformer-based neural network trained on a technical book focused on computer architecture, aimed at generating coherent technical text. The research primarily investigates the impact of context length on the quality and coherence of generated text. It explores how variations in the input context length influence the model's ability to generate text that closely resembles the style and content of the training material. Experimental results demonstrate significant variations in output quality based on context length, providing insights into optimizing transformer models for technical text generation. These findings have implications for the development of more efficient and effective automated documentation tools in the field of computer engineering.

articleTitle: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Solvers for Local Grid Capacity Planning Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The algorithms and software tools for solving large-scale NP-hard MILP (mixed-integer linear programming) problems are analyzed, specifically focusing on the modeling of electric power systems arising in the planning of the development of generating equipment. A generalized algorithm for solving such problems is defined, based on the possibility of their decomposition: investment costs for the construction of generating units and the number of such units are reflected in the master MILP subproblem, while the system operator's costs for the operation of generating units, as well as the technological indicators of their load for a set of electricity consumption graphs, are reflected in a set of independent secondary MILP subproblems. It is noted that for Local Grids with large shares of electricity production from renewable energy sources, the sets of independent secondary MILP subproblems are quite substantial. Therefore, the speed of solving the secondary MILP subproblems determines the speed of solving the original MILP problems of electric power system modeling. Based on the results of experimental studies using the SCIP, HiGHS, Cbc, and GLPK solvers to solve a test MILP problem of optimizing the generating capacity structure of a Local Grid, it was established that the SCIP and HiGHS solvers are appropriate for solving the secondary MILP subproblems.

articleTitle: Tumor Segmentation Based on Hybrid MR-Images for Radiation Treatment Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The development of tumor segmentation method using only MRI hybrid images is considered. Proposed original tumor segmentation algorithms based on different brain MRI methods and use of U-Net convolutional neural network allow evaluate the effectiveness and accuracy of tumor segmentation algorithms using only MRI images and select the most adequate combination of them for specific clinical conditions.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties and Electrical Conductivity as a Characteristic of Degradation of Coal Tar Wash Oil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Coal tar wash oil plays a crucial role in the absorption of benzene hydrocarbons from coke oven gas. During the operation of a benzene plant, the oil gradually loses its operational properties, necessitating the application of diverse physico-chemical analysis methods to identify causes and select suitable absorbents from different manufacturers. The use of additional methods of analysis allows to find out the causes of oil deterioration and make informed decisions on its recovery or replacement, thus ensuring constant efficiency of the benzene unit. It was found that the wash oil is subjected to temperature cycling stresses that are, in principle, characteristic of engine oils. This was the basis for the application of similar degradation testing methods, among which the most attractive are the determination of dielectric properties and electrical conductivity. Fresh oil consistently shows lower breakdown current densities than operating oils at all test voltages. Lean oil, particularly at higher voltages, has a notable increase in current density, suggesting worse breakdown performance. Fresh oil maintains the most stable breakdown behavior across voltages, while lean oil is the least stable. In addition, the electrical resistivity of coal tar flushing oil samples serves as a comprehensive indicator of changes in oil composition, molecular weight and contaminant accumulation, which provides valuable insights for quality assessment and further studies on oil degradation mechanisms.

articleTitle: Study of the Operational Regimes of the Sunbrick Solar Simulator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Experimental study of energy and spectrum features and operational regimes was provided for a measurement stand with light emitting diodes based Sunbrick solar simulator. Capabilities of the presented stand ensures the practically fully automatization of measurement process for illuminated current-voltages characteristics of test samples of solar cells. Presented device is capable to simulate various regimes of solar radiation in the wide range of their energy and spectrum characteristics, including standart for photovoltaic industry spectrums like AM0, AM1.5, AM 1.5G. As a result of series of experiments was studied the main parameters of complex like stability of light beam, spatial unevenness from area of investigated solar cells, possibilities of manual and automatic control the spectrum components of illumination.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamics of Electromechanical Tracking Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Purpose of work is improving control accuracy by nonlinear two-mass electromechanical tracking system with nonlinear friction dependencies and plant mechanical part uncertain parameters based on robust methods. Nonlinear robust regulators and nonlinear robust observers design reduced to Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations system solution. Robust control target vector calculation reduced to vector game solution. Vector game payoff is direct quality indicators in various modes operation system presented. Results of theoretical and experimental studies conducted on experimental installation of designed two-mass electromechanical tracking system are given.

articleTitle: Mobile Portable Power Plants Based on Heat Engines, Technical Condition Monitoring and Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper deals with the problems of building mobile electric power plants based on internal combustion engines with high technical, economic and environmental indicators, as well as with the issues of control optimization and assessment of the technical condition of the unit engines. Optimization of control of a power plant with gas-turbine supercharging is based on the maximum principle with the use of additive quality criterion, taking into account technical, economic and ecological indicators of the unit. Technical diagnostics of the power plant is based on statistical processing of time diagrams of the instantaneous angular velocity of the engine shaft rotation using histogram analysis of experimental data.

Author Keywords: monitoring of the technical condition of the engine unit

articleTitle: Design of Near-Zero Thermal Expansion Polymer Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to develop a methodology for designing polymer composites with near-zero effective coefficients of thermal expansion (CTE). The peculiarity of the proposed methodology is that the required result can be obtained by using components having positive CTE. The implementation is carried out on the example of unidirectional reinforced fiberglass with a square fiber packing scheme. The homogenization technique involves modeling of free temperature deformation of the composite in the absence of macro-stresses. The micromechanical analysis within a representative cell is performed by the finite element method. The method involves iteratively altering boundary conditions to ascertain the effective elements of the thermal expansion tensor. At certain physical characteristics of fibers and matrix, relative radii of fibers were found at which thermal expansion in the plane perpendicular to the reinforcement is practically absent.

articleTitle: Methodology for Quantitative Assessment of Quality Characteristics in Distributed Systems and Microservices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The thesis discusses a new methodological approach called flexible quality assessment, aimed at improving the methodology based on the adaptive quality assessment approach used to address issues related to the uncertainty of quantitative assessment of quality characteristics in distributed systems and microservices. It analyzes the shortcomings of the adaptive quality assessment method and presents a mathematical framework for the new methodological solution, in which static probabilities are replaced by Bayesian networks that update probabilities based on new data. The mathematical model is developed based on the combined application of classical aspects of probability theory, Bayesian networks, the use of a semi-iterative approach for updating weights and assessments based on new data, as well as the use of DevOps practices for automating the deployment, monitoring, and updating of the system. The advantage of this approach is that the continuous refinement of the model based on new data allows for more accurate consideration of the dependencies between system components and their impact on reliability.

articleTitle: Basic Principles of Creation of Biomimetic Glass-Ceramic Materials for Dental Use
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Biomimetic approaches in the development of dental restorative materials were analyzed with the involvement of materials science approaches, aspects of tissue engineering and additive technologies. The main types of biomimetic materials for restoration of defects of dental defects, for direct restoration, for indirect restoration were analyzed. A methodological approach has been developed for the creation of biomimetic glass-ceramic materials for restorative dentistry, which consists in ensuring the flow of processes of osseointegration and biomechanics, which is determined by the chemical and phase composition of the material and its structure, energy, electrochemical properties and surface topography. Nanostructured glass-ceramic materials based on lithium calcium phosphate silicate glasses modified with zinc oxide and fluorite were developed. The formation of the structure of biomimetic glass- ceramic materials based on fluorapatite and lithium disilicate under conditions of low-temperature heat treatment was investigated and their prospects for use in the development of materials for restorative dentistry were established. The introduction of biomimetic principles in the creation of vitreous materials for dentistry will lead to the preservation of the natural structure of the tooth, the increase in the service life of restorative structures, the reduction of complications and the need for repeated treatment.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Management in Shopping Centers with Smart Grid and Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development and improvement of methods for managing the power supply of commercial buildings with high consumption. Specifically, it focuses on shopping centers, which are significant consumers of electricity. Smart Grid technology was chosen as a key element for optimizing the power supply management of large capacity facilities. Tasks were formulated aimed at developing general approaches and methods of modernization of existing shopping centers. The article presents a synthesized power source management system that takes into account the features of objects with high electricity consumption. Attention is focused on practical applications of modeling results, which can contribute to the implementation of advanced solutions in the field of power supply management of large power facilities. It is noted that the proposed methods and systems can ensure the efficient operation of energy systems taking into account modern requirements for stability and energy efficiency. The modes of operation of the commercial building were analyzed. A mathematical model of a shopping center with installed solar panels and that takes into account the operating power of the equipment has been developed. The results of the modeling made it possible to estimate the potential of reducing energy consumption when implementing solar energy systems. The obtained figures emphasize both the economic feasibility and the energy benefits of using renewable energy sources in commercial buildings.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis and Modification of the Rotor System with Passive and Active Magnetic Bearings to Improve its Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper discusses a laboratory operating model of a rotor in full magnetic suspension. It is considered as a prototype for small and medium-sized energy machines. The suspension is implemented using two radial passive magnetic bearings made of ring permanent magnets and one axial active magnetic bearing with double-sided stator armored cores of power electromagnets and a control system to create the necessary stabilizing forces depending on the current state (rotor position, and, as an option, rotor speed, as well as currents in the windings). To measure and analyze the dynamic characteristics of this rotor system, a developed specialized software and hardware complex is used. The use of this complex made it possible to determine the vibration amplitudes of the rotor support sections and the trajectories of their motion at various rotational speeds in the range from 0 to 3000 rpm. The results are presented in the form of three-dimensional spectrograms and amplitude-frequency characteristics for each degree of freedom of the rigid rotor, namely the radial displacements of the centers of two radial support sections of the rotor in two orthogonal directions (horizontal and vertical) and the center of the axial support section in the axial direction. The analysis of these data allowed identifying and generalizing the linear and nonlinear phenomena of rotor dynamics in the considered system with passive and active magnetic bearings. This gives an idea of the possible critical modes in systems of this type, and ways to suppress them to avoid resonances in the operating speed ranges or reduce the amplitudes of resonant vibrations. For the laboratory rig, a design modification option was proposed, which made it possible to improve the dynamic characteristics with a decrease in the range of nonlinear vibrations when the rotor moves in the form of cylindrical and conical precession.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Forecasting Quality Indicators of Predough Production in the Bakery Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work demonstrates the process of developing a machine learning model for a system for monitoring and controlling the quality of predough at a bakery. This system will provide continuous analysis of the predough parameters, such as temperature, humidity, lifting force and titranic acidity, which will ensure timely detection of deviations in the quality of the predough and avoid production problems. In addition, it will help automate the quality control process and ensure the stability of production processes. Analysis and forecasting of dough parameters will improve the quality of produced bread or other bakery products. Management based also on the predicted values of technological indicators of the predough will allow the enterprise to avoid unnecessary costs of materials and energy and increase economic efficiency. As part of the study, seven machine learning models were created and reviewed, including three linear and four varieties of binary decision trees. An analysis of the best model - a regression decision tree - was carried out, confirming its effectiveness and the validity of the resulting hierarchical structure, in particular, the prediction of important indicators of predough with a high degree of reliability, which indicates its importance in practical applications in production. The created model can be used to monitor and control product quality in real time, allowing operators to quickly identify and correct any deviations in process performance. Also, by analyzing changes in the variables of the predough production process, it is possible to identify precursors of possible production accidents or deviations in product quality, which will allow timely measures to be taken to avoid them.

articleTitle: Pecularities of Apparatus Methods of Diagnostics of Skin Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Skin diseases are often challenging to diagnose accurately due to their diverse manifestations. This study aims to explore the peculiarities of apparatus-based diagnostic methods, such as dermatoscopy, UV-videodermatoscopy, which offer more precise and objective assessments compared to traditional techniques. The results demonstrate that these advanced methods significantly improve diagnostic accuracy and early detection, benefiting dermatologists and clinical researchers. By enhancing the understanding of skin disease pathology, these techniques contribute to better patient outcomes and support the development of new therapeutic approaches. This research underscores the importance of adopting innovative diagnostic technologies in dermatological practice.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Heat Pump Horizontal Ground Heat Exchanger Operation on the Soil Thermal State
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: When designing heat pump heating systems using ground heat, one of the current tasks is the selection of rational thermodynamic operating modes of the heat pump. The aim of the article is to create a convenient tool for selecting the operating and design parameters of horizontal ground heat exchangers (GHE) of ground source heat pumps, taking into account the impact of their operation on the thermal potential of the soil. The temperature field of the soil mass undisturbed by the influence of the ground heat exchanger was studied. Based on solving the coupled problem of heat conduction in the soil and heat exchange in the GHE in a non-stationary formulation using the experimental design method, a regression equation of the heat flow from the soil to the linear meter of the GHE with a coolant on the main operating and design parameters of the GHE was obtained. Using the obtained regression equation, the impact of GHE operation on the depletion of the soil's thermal potential, as well as the effect of thermal interference between parallel sections of the GHE pipe, was studied. As a result of numerical studies, the most rational option of GHE with 9 parallel pipes with a spacing of 1 m between them was selected. The obtained results will allow the soil to be used as an energy source for a long time without leading to its thermal depletion while providing the required level of heat production in the heat pump.

articleTitle: Portable Device for Purifying and Disinfecting Water in Extreme Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 5th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
